name: Admin Accounting Settings
description: Superuser configures accounting email notifications at /panel/accounting/settings. The recipient list is its own catalog (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/accounting/notification-recipients/, audited): every row shows the address, whether it is Activo or Pausado and its fecha de alta; adding validates the format and rejects duplicates case-insensitively with the error inline; a per-row switch pauses a recipient without deleting it; each row leads with a three-dots menu (Detalle e historial, Ver nota, Quitar) and removing asks for confirmation naming the automations that stop arriving. Each row saves on its own, not through the page's save button. Every automated email of the module — change notices, card-debt and statement reminders, the payment calendar, cuentas de cobro and hosting payment outcomes — goes to the active recipients and to nobody else. The master switch (notifications_enabled, PATCH /api/accounting/settings/update/) pauses all of it at once; with it off, or with zero active recipients, the panel warns explicitly that nobody is being notified. Also hosts the weekly card-debt reminder toggle (Fridays 9:00 Bogotá, re-alert every 2 days until the snapshot is registered), the statement reminder toggle (every 8 days at 9:05 Bogotá while the previous month's statement of an active catalog card is missing, draft or lacks its PDF), the 'Catálogo de tarjetas' section (see admin-accounting-card-catalog), the hosting expiry notices toggle (15/7 days before valid_to, then every 5 days until the cuenta de cobro is sent), the USD exchange rate used by the recurring USD KPI, the 'Vista de ingresos' segmented control (income_default_view_mode: whether /panel/accounting/incomes lands grouped by client or as the classic table on every visit; the in-page toggle is session-only), and the globally persisted Cuentas de cobro view/criterion pair (grouped or classic, client or project), which can also be saved immediately from that list.
